pages.text: Turns $(l)organic waste$() into $(l)Biogas$(). It needs no power: just feed it.

It takes $(l)2 Cyber Frames$(), one above it and one on its left as you face it. Right-click it alone and drones show where they go. Once complete, the upper drum rises and a tank slides out beside it, its sight glass showing the gas. It doesn't work until then; breaking a frame folds it back.

$(li)Accepts $(l)anything a composter takes$() (seeds, crops, leaves, saplings, flowers...) and $(l)rotten flesh$().$(br)$(li)Each item takes 2 seconds. A sure-fire compost item (like a cake) gives $(l)250 mB$(), the others less, in proportion to their composting chance; rotten flesh gives $(l)200 mB$().

$(li)Holds $(l)8,000 mB$() and pushes the gas into adjacent $(l:cables/gas_pipe)Gas Pipes$(/l), tanks or a $(l:generators/gas_turbine)Gas Turbine$(/l). Pipes connect to the machine block, on its free sides.$(br)A Harvester drone and a hopper feeding the digester make a fully automatic biogas farm.
